verdict.rationale: Jira's marketing pages document a built-in AI, Rovo, that breaks big ideas into tasks, auto-assigns them, and creates automations that move work forward. That is product-native AI acting on work, but the evidence shows only feature-level AI assists rather than a documented assistant you hand open-ended tasks to. The 'assign work to your favorite coding agent' claim covers external agents, so it is not credited as the built-in assistant. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of delegating arbitrary tasks to the in-product assistant, depth or limits of what Rovo can execute autonomously, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Breakdown big ideas into actionable tasks and automatically assign them to the right person with Rovo AI.
Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
